summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of enhanced Student Card Editor features. All 11 test cases passed successfully. The feature correctly implements: 1) Portrait card format (320x400), 2) French flag visible on Classique template, 3) 'Drapeau France' button in left panel, 4) Enhanced text element properties (Fond de l'element, Arrondi, Opacite), 5) Rectangle element properties (Couleur de fond, Couleur bordure, Epaisseur bordure, Arrondi, Opacite), 6) 10 presets (Classique, Moderne, Premium, Ecologique, Technologique, Minimaliste, Colore, Institutionnel, Sportif, Artistique), 7) Institutionnel preset with French flag + REPUBLIQUE FRANCAISE + Liberte Egalite Fraternite, 8) Verso with CARTE D'ETUDIANT header, AVANTAGES section, QR code, legal mentions, 9) Template save with success toast, 10) Public verification page works for invalid codes.
